card.fact_statement: A ferry service from Kobe to Miyazaki was suspended following the earthquake.
card.answer: ferry service from Kobe to Miyazaki
card.source_span: suspended, along with a ferry service from Kobe to Miyazaki.

target_qa_variants.expected_answer: บริการเรือเฟอร์รี่จากโกเบไปยังมิยาซากิ
